headline: Nvidia Shares Head for Longest Weekly Losing Streak Since 2008
summary: Nvidia stock is on track for a stretch of weekly losses unseen since 2008. The company has erased $811 billion in market value over seven days amid ongoing uncertainty.
why: Nvidia is the world's leading designer of artificial intelligence semiconductors and a heavily weighted component in global equity indexes.

impacts.name: Nvidia Corporation
impacts.why: Nvidia shares have dropped over seven days, erasing $811 billion in market capitalization.
